Vulkan-Headers v1.3.290
======================
Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/tree/v1.3.290
Archive SHA-256: 918a8bb31b8312fd649fd1d1826443da870f33f3187c16c4528aa94927409bab

This directory carries the unmodified C core/platform/video headers required by
TFM's dynamically loaded Vulkan 1.0 compute service. No Vulkan loader, driver,
SDK executable or compiler is distributed. See LICENSES/ for upstream licenses.
